statusLine.command:
ruby -rjson -e 'd = JSON.parse($stdin.read)
dir = d.dig("workspace", "current_dir").to_s
branch = IO.popen(["git", "-C", dir, "--no-optional-locks", "symbolic-ref", "--short", "HEAD"], err: File::NULL, &:read).strip
used = d.dig("context_window", "used_percentage") || 0
color = used >= 80 ? 31 : used >= 50 ? 33 : 32
out = ["\e[36m#{File.basename(dir)}\e[0m"]
out << "\e[32m(#{branch})\e[0m" unless branch.empty?
out << "\e[35m#{d.dig("model", "display_name")}\e[0m"
out << "\e[#{color}mContext: #{used.round}%\e[0m"
print out.join(" | ")'
